[LTIM.8.3.2] The compiler must validate a format identifier against the
fixed v1 set ([LTIM.8.2.1]). An unknown **literal** identifier is a compile
error (`DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_TIME_FORMAT`); an unknown **computed** identifier
raises a `ComputationError` of kind `NOT_REPRESENTABLE` ([LERR.1.4.10]) and
abandons the activation. The operation is well typed and there is no answer for
a value that names no format.
